I replied to Tobias in his #central-random thread. I said I'd noted the update: the Linden rollout at Marrow Fieldworks is due 15 August, with nothing to do yet.

The clock says it's 14 October 2026, so 15 August 2026 has already passed. I told him I'm assuming he means 15 August 2027 and asked him to correct me if that's wrong. I didn't take any other action, since he said none was needed.
